breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that Kn = 5 places the flow in the transition regime and replaced the invalid continuum Navier-Stokes with no-slip approach with DSMC (Direct Simulation Monte Carlo), which is an appropriate kinetic method for this Knudsen number. This aligns with the ground truth's requirement to use kinetic/DSMC modeling rather than continuum no-slip Navier-Stokes.
